The '''Duluur Sector Naval Academy''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[academy]] in the [[Duluur sector/Legends|Duluur sector]]. [[Rear Admiral/Legends|Rear Admiral]] [[Michael Unther]] once gave a lecture there in [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] assault tactics.<ref name="WC">{{JournalCite|2|A World to Conquer}}</ref>
